title.en: A shift in geriatrics and family medicine

tagline.zh: 三個藥袋、一塊地毯和一班停駛的公車
tagline.en: Three medicine bags, a rug and a cancelled bus

desc.zh: 跟著許主治看診、聽診、會診；時間線由你問出來。
desc.en: See patients with Dr Hsu, auscultate, answer the consult; the timelines are yours to draw out.

desc.zh: 保健品、成藥、姿勢性血壓與居家支持都在你手上；你最知道病人回家後的樣子。
desc.en: Supplements, over-the-counter products, orthostatic blood pressures and home support are yours; you know what life looks like after they go home.

about.zh: 記得每位病人的狗叫什麼名字。午餐是一顆茶葉蛋，常常忘了剝。
about.en: Remembers the name of every patient's dog. Lunch is a tea egg she usually forgets to peel.

about.zh: 會把所有藥袋攤在桌上，一包一包對成分。口頭禪：清單不等於吃法。
about.en: Spreads every medicine bag on the bench and matches ingredients one by one. Catchphrase: the list is not how it is taken.

role.zh: 八十二歲，三家診所的藥

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。種蘭花。最近白天昏沉，澆花都會打瞌睡。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Grows orchids. Lately so drowsy by day she nods off watering them.

about.zh: 把三家的藥分進藥盒，很認真，也很累。
about.en: Sorts three clinics' medicines into a pill organiser. Diligent, and tired.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。退休郵差，每天走路去市場。堅持是地毯的錯。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Retired postman who still walks to the market daily. Insists it was the rug.

about.zh: 看得到病人家裡的冰箱。她的電話通常比檢驗報告更重要。
about.en: Sees inside patients' fridges. Her calls usually matter more than the lab report.

about.zh: 發現「太安靜」的人。會診單是她催的。
about.en: The one who notices “too quiet”. She chased the consult.

plain.zh: 同時吃很多種藥，常來自不同醫師；重複成分與交互作用的風險跟著變高。
plain.en: Taking many medicines at once, often from different doctors; the risk of duplicated ingredients and interactions rises with the count.

plain.zh: 診所或藥局給藥時附的袋子，上面印著藥名與用法；帶齊所有藥袋是核對的第一步。
plain.en: The labelled bag a clinic or pharmacy dispenses medicines in; bringing every bag is the first step of any check.

plain.zh: 把所有來源的藥和實際吃法對成一份正確的清單。
plain.en: Matching medicines from every source against how they are actually taken, to produce one correct list.

plain.zh: 維他命、草本、電視購物買的產品；不是處方，也可能和藥互相影響。
plain.en: Vitamins, herbal and television-shopping products; not prescriptions, yet they can still interact with medicines.

plain.zh: 躺著和站起來後分別量血壓，看站起來時有沒有掉太多。
plain.en: Blood pressure measured lying and then standing, to see whether it drops too far on standing.

plain.zh: 長者跌倒很少只有一個原因：藥、血壓、視力、肌力、環境，要一起看。
plain.en: An older person's fall rarely has one cause: medicines, blood pressure, eyesight, strength and the home all count.

plain.zh: 貼在胸口與手腳的電極，畫出心跳的節律。脈搏慢或不規則時要做。
plain.en: Electrodes on the chest and limbs that trace the heart's rhythm; done when the pulse is slow or irregular.

plain.zh: 護理師到病人家裡探視與照護，看得到診間看不到的事。
plain.en: Nurses who visit and care for patients at home, and see what a consulting room cannot.

plain.zh: 病人到不到得了醫療：交通、距離、時間、費用、語言。
plain.en: Whether a patient can actually reach care: transport, distance, time, cost and language.

plain.zh: 急性的注意力與意識波動，常由感染、藥物或疼痛引起；安靜型最容易被漏掉。
plain.en: An acute, fluctuating disturbance of attention and awareness, often triggered by infection, medicines or pain; the quiet type is the easiest to miss.

plain.zh: 和平常不一樣，而且是最近才開始的。家屬說「不像他」就是線索。
plain.en: Different from usual, and recent. A family saying “that's not like him” is the clue.

plain.zh: 別科請我們去看病人並給建議；回覆要具體，寫清楚誰追蹤。
plain.en: Another team asks us to see their patient and advise; the reply must be specific and name who follows up.

plain.zh: 回報與會診回覆的固定順序：身分、情境、背景、評估、建議。
plain.en: The fixed order for reports and consult replies: Identity, Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation.

text.zh: 袖帶大小要合手臂，手臂與心臟同高。姿勢性血壓要躺、站各量。
text.en: Cuff sized to the arm, arm at heart level. Orthostatic readings are taken lying and standing.

text.zh: 脈搏慢、不規則、頭暈跌倒的長者，依醫囑做十二導程心電圖。
text.en: For a slow or irregular pulse, or a dizzy faller, a twelve-lead ECG per order.

text.zh: 藥袋攤開、成分對齊、實際吃法寫旁邊。重複的用筆圈起來。
text.en: Bags spread out, ingredients lined up, actual use written beside each. Duplicates get circled.

text.zh: 今天的三個重點、誰負責、幾點回報。
text.en: Today's three priorities, who owns each, and when to report back.

text.zh: 長者上下床要有人扶，床邊放好拐杖。
text.en: Older patients need a hand on and off; keep the walking stick within reach.

text.zh: 玉蘭阿嬤自己曬的。她說醫師太瘦。
text.en: Sun-dried by Grandma Yu-Lan herself. She says the doctor is too thin.

text.zh: 不吵不鬧、一直睡、注意力散。因為安靜，最常被當成「年紀大了」而漏掉。
text.en: No agitation, just sleepiness and scattered attention. Because it is quiet, it is the one most often written off as “old age”.

text.zh: 地毯只是其中一個因子：藥物時間線、姿勢性血壓、視力、肌力、鞋子、燈光。
text.en: The rug is only one factor: medicine timeline, orthostatic pressure, eyesight, strength, footwear, lighting.

lines.zh: 家醫科門診，早上七點四十五分。候診區已經有人在看電視購物。
lines.en: The family medicine clinic, quarter to eight. Someone in the waiting area is already watching the shopping channel.

lines.zh: 今天三個重點：玉蘭阿嬤的藥袋、金水伯的夜間跌倒、下午病房會診。
lines.en: Three things today: Grandma Yu-Lan's medicine bags, Uncle Jin-Shui's night-time fall, and a ward consultation this afternoon.

lines.zh: 阿嬤的藥來自三家診所。清單寫每天吃。你信嗎？
lines.en: Grandma's medicines come from three clinics. The list says daily. Do you believe it?

lines.zh: 先問她實際怎麼吃。
lines.en: Ask her how she actually takes them first.

lines.zh: 對。清單是清單，人是人。去把三家的藥袋清單找出來。
lines.en: Right. The list is the list, the person is the person. Go and find the three clinics' lists.

q.zh: 找出三家診所的藥袋清單
q.en: Find the lists from the three clinics

post.zh: 多重用藥的病人，核對從攤開所有東西開始。
post.en: With polypharmacy, the check starts by laying everything out.

note.zh: 阿嬤的藥：實際吃法記下來了

lines.zh: 醫師，我白天都昏昏的，澆花都會睡著。
lines.en: Doctor, I'm drowsy all day. I fall asleep watering the flowers.

lines.zh: 她有三家診所的藥，我都幫她分好了。
lines.en: She has medicines from three clinics. I sort them all for her.

lines.zh: 阿嬤，這一包您怎麼吃？
lines.en: Grandma, how do you take this bag?

lines.zh: 那包喔，不舒服才吃。
lines.en: That one? Only when I feel poorly.

lines.zh: 媽！清單寫每天！
lines.en: Mum! The list says every day!

post.zh: 先建立實際使用紀錄。清單寫的，不一定是吃的。
post.en: Build the record of actual use first. What the list says is not necessarily what goes in.

guide.en: Decide how to record that bag

lines.zh: 阿嬤的女兒拿出手機，準備拍藥盒。
lines.en: The daughter takes out her phone to photograph the pill organiser.

q.zh: 阿嬤說那包只在不舒服時吃，清單寫每天。你怎麼記？
q.en: Grandma says she takes that bag only when unwell; the list says daily. What do you record?

options.zh: 照實記「需要時」，標記待藥師複核
options.en: Record “as needed” as she says, flag for pharmacist review

why.zh: 藥歷寫事實；不確定的交給藥師。
why.en: The record states facts; the uncertainty goes to the pharmacist.

options.en: Write daily, as the list says

why.zh: 這是把清單當成已確認的使用情況。
why.en: That treats the list as confirmed use.

options.zh: 叫阿嬤以後都照清單吃
options.en: Tell Grandma to follow the list from now on

why.zh: 還不知道那包是什麼，先別改她的行為。
why.en: You don't yet know what that bag is; don't change her behaviour yet.

lines.zh: 阿嬤還有吃什麼保健品、成藥？電視上買的也算。
lines.en: Does Grandma take any supplements or over-the-counter products? Television purchases count.

lines.zh: 有啊，電視那個顧關節的，還有鄰居給的止痛藥。
lines.en: Yes, the joint one from the shopping channel, and painkillers a neighbour gave her.

lines.zh: 下次都帶來，連瓶子一起。藥師要看成分。
lines.en: Bring them all next time, bottles included. The pharmacist needs the ingredients.

lines.zh: 阿嬤，幫我把一年的月份倒著唸，從十二月開始。
lines.en: Grandma, say the months of the year backwards for me, starting from December.

lines.zh: 十二、十一、十……欸，到哪了？
lines.en: December, November, October… wait, where was I?

lines.zh: 注意力不集中。是藥、是睡眠、還是別的？把開始時間問出來。
lines.en: Inattention. Medicines, sleep or something else? Get the start date.

note.zh: 春嬌阿婆：檢驗穩定，生活退步
note.en: Grandma Chun-Jiao: stable tests, failing routines

sub.zh: 春嬌阿婆兩次沒回診，冰箱是空的
sub.en: Grandma Chun-Jiao missed two visits; the fridge is empty

lines.zh: 春嬌阿婆兩次沒回診。今天去看，冰箱幾乎是空的。她說公車停駛了。
lines.en: Grandma Chun-Jiao has missed two appointments. I visited today and the fridge is nearly empty. She says the bus stopped running.

lines.zh: 她的檢驗都和上次差不多。
lines.en: Her tests are much the same as last time.

lines.zh: 對，檢驗穩定，生活退步了。她不想麻煩兒子。
lines.en: Yes. Stable tests, failing routines. She doesn't want to trouble her son.

lines.zh: 缺診不是不合作。先問到不到得了。
lines.en: A missed visit is not non-compliance. First ask whether she can get here.

post.zh: 我問問里辦公室有沒有接送。
post.en: I'll ask the village office about transport.

post.zh: 先問阿婆願不願意。就醫可近性是她的，決定也是她的。
post.en: Ask Grandma first whether she wants it. The accessibility problem is hers, and so is the decision.

note.zh: 用藥整合：重複成分圈出來了

lines.zh: 許主治的午餐是一顆茶葉蛋，放在桌上沒剝。
lines.en: Dr Hsu's lunch is a tea egg, sitting unpeeled on the desk.

lines.zh: 玉蘭阿嬤的藥袋我攤開了。三家診所，兩種成分重複。用藥整合開始。
lines.en: I've laid out Grandma Yu-Lan's medicine bags. Three clinics, two duplicated ingredients. Medication reconciliation begins.

lines.zh: 你記的「需要時」救了我：那包和另一家的成分一樣，照清單抄會算成雙倍。
lines.en: Your “as needed” note saved me: that bag has the same ingredient as another clinic's, and copying the list would have counted it double.

lines.zh: 藥歷寫事實。你做對了。
lines.en: The record states facts. You did it right.

lines.zh: 清單寫每天，我差點把它算成每天雙倍。你問過阿嬤實際怎麼吃嗎？
lines.en: The list says daily, and I nearly counted it as a daily double. Did you ask Grandma how she actually takes it?

lines.zh: ……她說不舒服才吃。我寫成每天了。
lines.en: …She said only when unwell. I wrote daily.

lines.zh: 回去改。藥歷寫的是事實，不是清單。
lines.en: Go and change it. The record is facts, not the list.

lines.zh: 白天昏沉，哪一包最可疑？
lines.en: Daytime drowsiness: which bag is the prime suspect?

lines.zh: 先整理症狀和每一包開始的時間，不直接指最後一包。
lines.en: Line up the symptom against when each bag started, rather than blaming the latest one.

lines.zh: 還有女兒說的保健品。沒看到瓶子以前，不算核對完。
lines.en: And the supplements the daughter mentioned. Until we see the bottles, the check isn't finished.

note.en: A fall is more than a rug

lines.zh: 地毯啦，半夜去廁所被地毯絆到。
lines.en: The rug. Tripped on the rug going to the toilet in the night.

lines.zh: 跌倒之前，有頭暈嗎？
lines.en: Before the fall, were you dizzy?

lines.zh: 有啊，上個月換藥以後，站起來會暈一下。
lines.en: Yes, since they changed my medicine last month I go dizzy when I stand.

lines.zh: 地毯找到了，問診就結束了嗎？
lines.en: You found the rug. Is the history finished?

post.zh: 跌倒很少只有一個原因。症狀、視力、肌力、藥，一起看。
post.en: A fall rarely has one cause. Symptoms, eyesight, strength, medicines, all together.

lines.zh: 金水伯，先躺一下，我量兩次血壓，一次躺、一次站。
lines.en: Uncle Jin-Shui, lie down for a moment. I'll take your pressure lying and then standing.

steps.zh: 站立後一分鐘量第二次
steps.en: Second reading one minute after standing

steps.zh: 站立後三分鐘量第三次
記錄數值並詢問有無頭暈
steps.en: Record the values and ask about dizziness

post.zh: 站起來後血壓掉了，他說有一點暈。記下來交給醫師。
post.en: The pressure dropped on standing and he felt a little dizzy. Noted and passed to the doctor.

lines.zh: 脈搏有點慢又不太規則。我聽一下心臟，五個區，配著頸動脈的脈搏。
lines.en: The pulse is a bit slow and irregular. I'll listen to the heart, five areas, timed with the carotid pulse.

post.zh: 聽到什麼寫什麼。心電圖依醫囑安排。
post.en: Write what you hear. ECG per order.

lines.zh: 金水伯站起來要去廁所，忽然扶住桌子。監視器上的脈搏很慢。
lines.en: Uncle Jin-Shui stands to go to the toilet and suddenly grabs the desk. The monitor shows a very slow pulse.

lines.zh: 又來了，這種暈。
lines.en: There it is again, that dizziness.

options.zh: 扶坐、量血壓、心電圖，請主治核對用藥
options.en: Sit him down, pressure, ECG, attending to review the medicines

why.zh: 慢脈加頭暈：先安全，再找節律與藥物時間線。
why.en: Slow pulse plus dizziness: safety first, then rhythm and the medicine timeline.

why.zh: 這就是夜裡跌倒的那個暈。
why.en: This is the same dizziness that put him on the floor.

why.zh: 脈搏慢不是缺水的問題。
why.en: A slow pulse is not a water problem.

post.zh: 頭暈從換藥開始。藥物時間線交給游藥師，心電圖依醫囑，今天不讓他自己走回家。
post.en: The dizziness began with the medicine change. Timeline to Pharmacist Yu, ECG per order, and he is not walking home alone today.

guide.zh: 到影像工作站看跌倒傷害
guide.en: Check for injury at the workstation

lines.zh: 跌倒之後，先看有沒有受傷。哪裡最容易漏？
lines.en: After a fall, injury first. Where is the easiest miss?

question.zh: 跌倒後哪個部位的骨折最容易被漏掉？
question.en: Which fracture is most often missed after a fall?

answer.zh: 髖部與骨盆。不能承重、腿變短外旋、腹股溝痛都要照影像；沒撞頭也要問有沒有失去意識。
answer.en: The hip and pelvis. Inability to bear weight, a shortened and rotated leg, or groin pain all need imaging; and even without a head strike, ask about loss of consciousness.

note.en: Consult: the grandfather who went quiet

guide.en: Go to bed 3 for the consult

sub.zh: 3 床阿公今天很安靜，家屬說不像他
sub.en: Bed 3 is very quiet today; the family says it's not like him

lines.zh: 他不躁動，就是一直睡。叫得醒，可是注意力散掉。
lines.en: He's not agitated, just sleeping all the time. Rousable, but his attention is gone.

lines.zh: 床邊的孫女說：「阿公平常會跟每個人聊天。」
lines.en: The granddaughter at the bedside says: “Grandpa normally chats to everyone.”

lines.zh: 這不是他平常的樣子，就是急性變化。
lines.en: Not his usual self means an acute change.

post.zh: 安靜型譫妄最容易被漏掉。感染、新藥、睡眠、疼痛、便秘，一個一個找。
post.en: Hypoactive delirium is the easiest to miss. Infection, new medicines, sleep, pain, constipation: look for each in turn.

lines.zh: 會診回覆用 ISBAR 寫。建議要具體，誰追蹤要寫名字。
lines.en: Write the consultation reply in ISBAR. Make the recommendations specific and name who follows up.

lines.zh: 評估：急性注意力變化，疑譫妄。建議：找誘因、避免新增鎮靜藥、家屬陪伴、明早再評估，追蹤者寫我。
lines.en: Assessment: acute change in attention, probable delirium. Recommendation: hunt the trigger, no new sedatives, family at the bedside, reassess tomorrow morning; follow-up: me.

lines.zh: 很好。你把自己的名字寫上去了。
lines.en: Good. You put your own name on it.

lines.zh: 今天沒有一個人的病名是答案。
lines.en: Not one person's diagnosis was the answer today.

lines.zh: 阿嬤是藥袋，金水伯是時間線，春嬌阿婆是一班公車，阿公是「不像他」。
lines.en: Grandma was a medicine bag, Uncle Jin-Shui a timeline, Grandma Chun-Jiao a bus, and Grandpa was “not like him”.

lines.zh: 家庭醫學看的是人在生活裡的樣子。明天繼續。
lines.en: Family medicine looks at people inside their lives. Same again tomorrow.

lines.zh: 茶葉蛋還是沒剝。
lines.en: The tea egg is still unpeeled.

sub.zh: 阿嬤要我把這包龍眼乾給你
sub.en: Grandma wants you to have this bag of dried longan

lines.zh: 阿嬤說醫師太瘦，這是她自己曬的龍眼乾，放在櫃台了。
lines.en: Grandma says the doctor is too thin. She dried these longans herself; they're at the front desk.

lines.zh: 請跟阿嬤說謝謝。下次記得帶瓶子來。
lines.en: Please thank her. And remember the bottles next time.

sub.zh: 春嬌阿婆願意讓鄰居載她來回診
sub.en: Grandma Chun-Jiao will let a neighbour drive her to clinic

lines.zh: 春嬌阿婆說，鄰居每週三要來市區，她願意搭便車來回診。她自己決定的。
lines.en: Grandma Chun-Jiao says her neighbour drives into town every Wednesday and she's happy to come with him. Her own decision.

lines.zh: 她自己決定的，這最重要。謝謝你今天的電話。
lines.en: Her own decision is what matters most. Thank you for today's call.

lines.zh: 你把龍眼乾放進包包。明天的晨會，又是三個重點。
lines.en: You put the dried longan in your bag. Tomorrow's huddle will have three priorities again.

sub.en: The list is the list; the person is the person
